issues.issue: The back and cushion fabric is a two-tone blue cloth: a saturated mid-blue ground with dim light dashes. ANA's is a three-tone grey-blue dash mosaic: near-white dashes AND navy-slate dashes on a lighter grey-blue ground, with roughly equal light and dark dash coverage. At cabin distance the model reads as periwinkle denim, and the official photos read as grey tweed.
issues.evidence: Pixels below 0.75x the median: py_37301 back 12 % (#5b6983), py_37303 32 % (#4d576a), py_37302 foreground 7 %. Model q14 0 %, q13 3 %. Light-dash colour: photo #cddcf1 / #d8e3f4, model #919cbb. Medians: py_37301 #8f9db5 (saturation 0.21), py_37302 mid rows #7d8696 (0.17); model q14 #667092 (0.30), q13 mid #6e799a (0.29). Contrast (p90-p10)/p50: photo 0.57-0.86, model 0.33-0.52. Gradient energy: model gx 11, photo 20-27.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py synth_py_back: add a dark dash set interleaved with the light one. In the same r/c loop, draw a second dash at x0 + cw/2 (jitter ±6 px, length N(16,4) clip 8-24, band half-width 2.4 px) into a 'dark' array with weight U(0.7,1.0), and set out = (1 + 2.8*lite) * (1 - 0.45*dark). Seed about 30 % of cells as dark-dominant (light dash x0.4) and 15 % as light-dominant (dark dash x0.3) so the photo's mottled patches return. Then raise the base: src/09_seats.js pyFabric c '#787f9a' -> '#7e8598' (saturation about 0.17, mean L about +8). Target: q14 back median about #8590a8, light dashes over 200 L, 10-20 % of pixels below 0.75x the median, (p90-p10)/p50 about 0.6.

issues.issue: The headrest wings render as flat pale-grey pillows with faint flecks, so they stand out as two light blobs on every seat (q13 most clearly). On ANA's photos the wings are domed, have strong pillow shading, and show bright cream petals on a darker slate ground.
